title: Nine Lines on Page Six
subtitle: 广告与传媒 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 广告与传媒（社会服务与人际沟通·广告与传媒）
meta: 主题语境：广告与传媒（社会服务与人际沟通·广告与传媒）　|　核心词汇：ad　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ad 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 my father put ① an ad in a paper for nine days and got one reply, which he said was nine more than he deserved. The ② ad, meaning the nine lines and not the thing he was selling, cost eleven pounds and a morning; an ad, my mother said, is the only writing that admits it wants something and pays for the privilege. She said the privilege was the expensive half.

Every ③ ad in that paper was four lines and a promise, and she said the promises were all the same length. Their ④ ad with the misprint sold the thing twice and delivered it once; an ad, my father said, is the only kind of writing that is judged by how many people did not read it. He said nine thousand people did not read his.

My grandmother thought ⑤ ads were news with the interesting part removed, and she read them for eleven years. The ⑥ ad, meaning the whole business and not one notice, is nine parts hope and one part arithmetic; an ad, she said, is the only thing in a newspaper that is honest about wanting your money. She said the news is never honest about that.

By 1981 the ⑦ ad had been answered by a man who wanted something else entirely. The ⑧ ad on the back of the paper, which nobody was meant to see, had nine words and no address; an ad, my father said, is either a shout or a whisper, depending on who is paying. He said the back page is where the whispering happens.

The ⑨ ad I remember is the nine lines, which my grandmother cut out and kept for years. An ⑩ ad, she said in 1984, is the only literature written by somebody who does not expect to be believed; every ad, she said, is a small hope with a price on it. She said she had kept eleven of them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 广告（一则具体的广告）
B. n. 广告（指那九行文字，与所卖的东西相对）
C. n. 广告（指登错字的那一则）
D. 固定搭配：put an ad in a paper 在报纸上登广告
E. n. （复数 ads）广告；广告这一类
F. n. 广告（指广告这一行当、整个行当）
G. n. 广告（指报纸背面那则）
H. n. 广告（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: an ad in a paper for nine days
The ad, meaning the nine lines
ads were news with the interesting part removed
The ad, meaning the whole business
The ad on the back of the paper

answers.why: put an ad in a paper 意为“在报纸上登广告”，1979 年父亲在一家报纸上登了九天广告，只收到一封回信。
ad 指“那九行文字”，与他所卖的东西相对，这则广告花掉十一镑和一个上午。
ad 意为“广告”，那家报纸上每一则广告都是四行字加一个承诺。
ad 指登错字的那一则，他们那则印错的广告把那样东西卖了两次，只交付了一次。
ads 为复数，意为“广告、广告这一类”，祖母觉得广告就是被抽掉了有趣部分的消息，她读了十一年。
ad 指“广告这一行当”，与某则启事相对，是九分希望加一分算计。
ad 意为“广告”，到 1981 年回应这则广告的是个完全想要别的东西的人。
ad 指报纸背面那一则，本来没人该看见的，只有九个词，没有地址。
ad 意为“广告”，我记得的是那九行，祖母把它剪下来保存了好多年。
ad 为抽象总称，泛指“广告这种文字”，她说广告是唯一一种由并不指望被相信的人写的文学。
